description: Change an event. Only the fields given change; a new start with no end keeps the event's length. On a recurring event, the eventId decides the reach: an instance id from agenda changes that one occurrence, and a series id (every occurrence) is refused unless scope is "series". attendees replaces the guest list, and the result says who that added and removed. Guests are NOT emailed unless send_updates says so. meet: true adds a Meet link to an event without one. An event's type cannot change; a focus time or out of office event takes new auto_decline, decline_message and chat_status.

account.description: Which account this writes to: a label from list_accounts. Required; writes have no default.

attendees.description: Guest email addresses. On an update this REPLACES the guest list; the result lists who that added and removed.

auto_decline.description: Focus time and out of office only: which invitations Calendar declines while it lasts. "none" (the default), "new" (only those that arrive meanwhile) or "all" (every conflicting one, accepted ones too). Each decline is mail to that organiser.

busy.description: Whether it blocks time ("show as busy"). Default true.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id, from list_calendars or from an agenda event's calendarId. "primary" is the account's own.

chat_status.description: Focus time only: the status Google Chat shows meanwhile.

decline_message.description: Focus time and out of office only: the note a decline carries.

duration_minutes.description: Length when end is omitted. Default: an hour for a new event; on an update, the length it already had.

end.description: Same forms as start, and the same kind. All-day ends are EXCLUSIVE: a one-day event on the 29th ends on the 30th. Omit to use duration_minutes.

meet.description: true: Google makes a new Meet call for the event, and the result carries its link (meetingUrl). On an update, adds one to an event that has none.

recurrence.description: Repeat rule as RFC 5545 lines: ["RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY"] for a birthday, ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR"] for a gym slot. On an update of a series this REPLACES the rule; [] stops it repeating.

reminders_minutes.description: Popup reminders, in minutes before the start, replacing the calendar's defaults. [] means none.

scope.description: "one" (the default): the event or the one occurrence the eventId names. "series": required when the eventId is a whole recurring series, which this then changes in every occurrence.

send_updates.description: Who is emailed about this change: "none" (the default), "all" guests, or "externalOnly" (guests outside the domain).

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for a time in the server's zone (UTC), or RFC 3339 with an offset.
